assertions.assertion: Explains setting IssuerUri forces the same issuer/iss for every space
assertions.rationale: States the fixed IssuerUri bypasses inference so every space returns the same issuer/iss.

assertions.assertion: Recommends leaving IssuerUri unset so the issuer is inferred from each request's origin and path base
assertions.rationale: Says leave IssuerUri unset so issuer is inferred from request origin plus path base.

assertions.assertion: Notes that data and discovery endpoints remain separate per space even with a fixed IssuerUri
assertions.rationale: Parenthetical: 'Data and discovery endpoints still differ per space; only the issuer value is identical.'

assertions.assertion: Mentions the same applies to Multi-Issuer
assertions.rationale: States 'The same rule applies to Multi-Issuer.'
